profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Motivated, passionate, and detail-oriented full-stack software engineer at Microsoft. Skilled in public speaking and team leadership, with a strong drive to learn and tackle challenges.

positions.title: Founder/Owner
positions.description:
~Designed a unique piano curriculum and teach private piano lessons to students of all ages
~Professionally trained in and teach “Musikgarten: Music Makers at the Keyboard” classes
~Work with organizations and individuals to create custom recordings and edit music

positions.title: Fellow- CUNY Tech Prep
positions.description:
~Selected for a competitive full stack JavaScript training program
~Learned in-demand technologies like React, Node + Express, and PostgreSQL as well as industry best practices for design, implementation, and deployment such as MVC, version control with Git/GitHub, agile & Scrum with Trello and Slack, test driven development, and CI/CD

honors.title: Selected for Golden Key International Honour Society
honors.issuer: Issued by Golden Key International Honour Society · Aug 2018
